description: fan-out over the docs with an explicit list (one branch per file) and a reducer; the reducer's result is scored against the planted facts (reducer output, QUA-05)

dispatch.title: Collect the payments facts
dispatch.task: List every operational fact in the payments docs under /work/docs, each with the file it comes from.
context: The docs are three short Markdown files under /work/docs: glossary.md, ledger-service.md and retry-policy.md.

worker.instructions: State each operational fact in your file on its own line and cite the file in the form (file.md).

reducer.instructions: Merge the branch results into one list: one fact per line, each ending with its source file in the form (file.md). Keep every fact; drop duplicates.

returns.shape: one operational fact per line, each ending with its source file in the form (file.md)
